编号 官方英文范例
001 It would be dangerous to drink two bottles of whiskey and drive a car.
002 It is very dangerous to cross a busy street before the light turns green.
003 It is really pleasant to take a walk early in the morning, listening to birds sing.
004 Most Japanese high school students go to a cram school to prepare for college entrance exams.
005 When waiting for the elevator to come or the traffic light to change, most Japanese people become irritated in only thirty seconds.
006 An elderly woman sitting next to me on the train asked me where I was going.
007 Tom told us that we should rent a car to get around the city because the public transportation was inconvenient.
008 Everyone should be free to decide when to get married and whether to have children.
009 It is impossible to predict where and when there will be a major earthquake.
010 Tom insisted that everything would be all right, but I could not help feeling worried.
011 It never occurred to me that my remark might hurt her feelings.
012 "Tom, dinner is ready." "OK, Mom. I'm coming."
013 I will call you when I get to Narita Airport.
014 If you take the train to Tokyo Disneyland from here, you have to change three times.
015 I have decided to look for a job abroad when I graduate from college.
016 This dryer doesn't work. Something seems to be wrong with it.
017 The best thing about my stay with an American family was that the parents treated me just like their daughter.
018 I lived in Canada for three years when I was in my teens because my father was transferred there.
019 The Internet is widely used, so sales of personal computers have been rapidly increasing over the last few years.
020 I have often heard Tom boast that he is very good at swimming, but I have never actually seen him swim.
021 It has been only a week since I began a part-time job at a convenience store, but I am already used to it.
022 When I got on the train this morning, I could not find an empty seat.
023 I am not wearing glasses now, so I cannot make out what the sign says.
024 Less than twenty-four hours after I return to my hometown, without realizing it, I start to talk in the local dialect.
025 Humans learn to express what they think by the age of five or six.
026 Thanks to the map you drew me the other day, I managed to get here without getting lost.
027 Last summer I took two weeks off, and went on a trip to Europe with my wife.
028 Bob had changed a lot, so when I saw him at a class reunion, I did not recognize him.
029 When I visited my hometown for the first time in twenty years, I found that it was no longer what it used to be.
030 I stayed up till four last night preparing for the math lesson, so I feel very sleepy.
031 I have finished reading the novel I borrowed from the library yesterday, so now I have nothing to do.
032 If you had taken this medicine and stayed in bed, you would probably have got well in two or three days.
033 The teacher says that we should wait here for a while because if we left now, we might get caught in a thunderstorm on the way.
034 People wish they could live forever and never become older. However, if this wish came true, there would be too many people on the earth.
035 Ann looks happy. Something good must have happened to her.
036 If you have been to old European cities, you must have been impressed by the beautiful streets.
037 Without fossil fuels such as oil and coal, the history of the 20th century would have been completely different.
038 Some students coming to the library act as if they are in a café.
039 When I was a child, I often wished my house were a little larger.
040 I would like to work as a volunteer helping victims of natural disasters, such as floods or earthquakes.
041 Tom has nice drums, and he never lets anyone else play them.
042 At first I thought Tom was joking, but later I realized he was serious.
043 Last Sunday I tried making some Italian food for the first time, and it was delicious.
044 Some people say that they do not like summer because it is so hot that they do not feel like doing anything. However, I like the heat of summer because I can swim in the sea.
045 James came to Japan eight years ago not only because he wanted to visit temples, but also because he had a Japanese girlfriend.
046 I am against human cloning. That is because it could cause duplication of dictators.
047 The graph shows that in Japan the birth rate has been decreasing since 1985. This decrease is partly because it costs a lot of money to raise children.
048 I apologized to Ann for being late, but she did not forgive me.
049 During the math class, my cell phone began to ring, and the teacher severely scolded me. I regretted that I had not turned it off.
050 I am so busy doing the housework every day that I have no time to see a movie.
051 This wooden desk is too heavy for me to carry upstairs alone.
052 While traveling in Europe, I was disappointed that wherever I went, there were many Japanese tourists.
053 I was very happy when I saw my mother going to work wearing the earrings I had bought her.
054 If you expect that schools only teach academic subjects, then this proves that you do not understand what schools are for.
055 Most Japanese people spend most of their time working to live.
056 Japanese people usually express their feelings as indirectly as possible so that they will not offend others.
057 Whether a college is good or bad depends not only on how many books its library has and how good they are. It also depends on how intelligent its teachers and students are.
058 The increase in the amount of CO₂ in the atmosphere is closely connected with global warming.
059 The more modern civilization advances, the longer we are forced to stay up at night, and the less sleep we get.
060 Doctors and teachers are alike in that both of them deal not with things but with people.
061 Professional baseball is far more exciting at a stadium than on TV.
062 This motorbike is about twice as expensive in the U.K. as in Japan.
063 Just because young people today read less than they used to, it does not always follow that they are less eager to learn.
064 Frankly speaking, the entrance exams I took yesterday were far more difficult than I had expected.
065 A lot of people have personal computers, but very few of them know how to use them effectively.
066 A lot of housewives complain that prices are too high.
067 In some countries people have too much food, while in others tens of thousands of children are starving.
068 Don't forget to turn off the air conditioner before you go to bed, or you'll catch a cold.
069 There is a saying that a cold can cause a variety of diseases. Take care not to catch a cold.
070 On the Internet, you can exchange thoughts and ideas with people all over the world, regardless of their age, sex, or nationality.
071 However much exercise you get, you will not lose weight unless you count your calories.
072 Although you believe you know a word, you may learn something new if you look it up in the dictionary.
073 Some Japanese tourists lack common sense and carry a lot of cash in their backpockets.
074 In order to stay healthy, you should have a balanced diet and get regular exercise.
075 If you live in a developing country for a while, you have an opportunity to look at Japan from a different point of view.
076 It is not until you go abroad that you realize how many neon lights there are in big Japanese cities.
077 It is a pity that many Japanese people mistakenly believe that they have only to speak English to be internationally-minded.
078 It is surprising that many Americans do not care how you pronounce English as long as they can understand what you are trying to say.
079 The best things you can do to protect nature are to reduce garbage and to use environmentally friendly products.
080 It is said that seven out of ten young Japanese people do not believe in religion.
081 Ways of greeting vary from country to country. In Japan, bowing is more common than shaking hands.
082 Hamamatsu is located east of Lake Hamana, which is famous for its beautiful scenery and delicious seafood.
083 Quite a few elderly women look down on their husbands, who cannot do anything by themselves and ask too much of them.
084 The movie theater is about twenty minutes' walk from here, but it takes only five minutes to get there by subway.
085 It cost ten thousand yen to have this bike repaired.
086 There are four people in my family. Our apartment is on the fifth floor of this building.
087 The tendency for young people to believe everything that is printed is nothing new.
088 When I was studying in Paris, a famous painter bought me a meal at a first-class restaurant.
089 Tom finally realized his dream of becoming an astronaut, but at the expense of many other things.
090 If city life gives you stress and fatigue, it is best to relax in the mountains or on beaches in order to relieve them.
091 In Japan, women have difficulty getting promoted or returning to their jobs after giving birth and raising their children.
092 In the U.S., parents drive their children everywhere until they are old enough to get a driver's license.
093 "Excuse me. Could you tell me how to get to the post office?" "Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. You'll find it on your right."
094 "What do you think of our new teacher?" "There is something about her that attracts me."
095 People who do not feel guilty about occupying two seats on a crowded train really make me angry.
096 Everyone is born with a talent. The question is whether they can find it or not.
097 When I left the office for lunch, I ran into an old friend from high school.
098 This music is worth listening to over and over again. I recommend it.
099 Teeth play an important role in your health. If you want to stay healthy, you should brush your teeth after every meal.
100 Bear in mind that if you have enthusiasm, you can succeed in anything.

  • 编号 073：原书正文页与卷末リスト均为 backpockets（此前对照表误录为 backpacks，已按原书订正）。
